svg.text: Merged Bundle entrances: preserving the dynamic crown through the join
Smooth input paths | direct quads | exact complete mouth interfaces | drawn from the saved qualified meshes
Blue: junction surface Green: dynamic-profile road strips Magenta: exact shared mouth edges
The strips end at prepared body cuts. Full road runs, separator/cap events, ownership and normal Update integration remain unfinished.
All 22 joined test meshes pass float32 quad, slope, outline and global overlap checks. No triangles are constructed.
